text.text_excerpt: I'm not really a huge wing person, but I heard very good things about Bouree and figured I'd give it a try. The menu is very simple, but just enough for the spot. I ended up going with the spicy pork boudin and the smoke & seasoned wings. The boudin was spot on. Enough spice to have a nice but of heat but not too much. I wouldn't say that it rivaled the boudin I normally get from Lafayette but it's definitely the best I've had here in New Orleans. The wings were very wood. Once I let them cool down I was actually able to taste the deep smoky flavor in them. They were nice and meaty and had just enough smoke to balance the spices in the seasoning. I loved checking out Bourrée for dinner! They have outdoor seating with heaters/fire pits for when it's cold, and they also have live music. You order up at a counter and someone comes and brings you your food. The Buffalo Cauliflower Poboy was amazing, and I also loved the Fried Brussel Sprouts! The Pepper Jack Stuffed Boudin balls and Sweet Mango BBQ wings were good as well. They also have chargrilled oysters right now which were delicious. Overall, the atmosphere and food was fantastic, and I will definitely be back!

This was my first visit to Bourree and I had heard nothing but good things. I really wanted the chicken wings but everything on the menu looks so good. So we did get a lot. I started off with their fresh daiquiris and it was so good. I had the hurricane. Then we just ordered the boudin balls, the chili cheese fries, wings, brisket poboy, and nachos. My fave item was the nachos. I love the cheese and the jalopenos on it. The boudin balls were my next fave. I love a good boudin ball. They had some house made ranch and something else that I could've just poured all of it on everything. The seating is lacking a little bit but they do have live music on the weekends.
